questions.q: How do I create an account on SERVOP?
questions.a: Click 'Sign Up' in the top-right corner, enter your name, email and a password, and you're in. You can start browsing right away — you only need to add more details if you plan to sell products or list a service.

questions.q: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
questions.a: On the Login page, click 'Forgot password?' and follow the instructions sent to your registered email to set a new one.

questions.q: Can I change my username or profile details later?
questions.a: Yes. Once logged in, open your profile settings to update your name, username, contact details and photo at any time.

questions.q: How do I delete my account?
questions.a: Contact us through the Support page and we'll process your deletion request, including removal of your personal data, within a few business days.

questions.q: How do I find products or services near me?
questions.a: Use the search bar on the homepage or tap 'Use My Location' — SERVOP shows nearby shops, service providers and trending products, ranked by distance and relevance.

questions.q: How do I contact a seller or service provider?
questions.a: Open any shop, product or service page and use the contact details or 'Book Now' / 'Contact' button shown on that profile.

questions.q: Can I compare prices between shops?
questions.a: Yes. Search results and shop pages sort products by price so you can quickly spot the cheapest and best-value options nearby.

questions.q: What if a seller doesn't respond or the listing looks incorrect?
questions.a: Report it from the listing page or reach out via our Support page and our team will look into it.

questions.q: How do I list my shop, products or services on SERVOP?
questions.a: Click 'Start Yours' from the More menu after logging in, choose Shop or Service Provider, and follow the guided setup to add your details, products and pricing.

questions.q: Is there a fee to list my business?
questions.a: Creating a basic listing is free. Optional premium visibility features, where available, are clearly marked with their pricing before you opt in.

questions.q: How do I manage my products, sales and analytics?
questions.a: Once you're set up as a seller, switch to Analytics View from the header to access your dashboard for products, sales tracking and performance insights.

questions.q: Can I switch between using SERVOP as a buyer and as a seller?
questions.a: Yes. Use the 'Switch to Consumer View' / 'Switch to Analytics View' toggle in the header to move between the two seamlessly.

questions.q: Does SERVOP process payments between buyers and sellers?
questions.a: SERVOP is primarily a discovery platform connecting you with local shops and service providers. Payment is typically arranged directly with the seller unless a listing states otherwise.

questions.q: Is my payment information stored on SERVOP?
questions.a: We don't store full card details on our servers. Any optional in-platform payments are processed through secure, PCI-compliant third-party payment providers.
Refunds for products or services purchased directly from a seller follow that seller's own refund policy. Contact Support if you need help resolving a dispute.

questions.q: The website isn't loading properly. What should I do?
questions.a: Try refreshing the page, clearing your browser cache, or switching browsers. If the issue persists, let us know through the Support page with a screenshot if possible.

questions.q: I found a bug or something looks broken.
questions.a: We'd love to know! Use the Contact & Support page to describe what happened and which page it occurred on — our team reviews every report.

questions.q: Does SERVOP work on mobile devices?
questions.a: Yes, the entire platform is fully responsive and works smoothly on phones, tablets and desktops.
